scripts.test:e2e:preview-namespace: : "${VITE_LOOP_STORAGE_NAMESPACE:?missing VITE_LOOP_STORAGE_NAMESPACE}" && : "${LOOP_EXPECTED_STORAGE_KEY:?missing LOOP_EXPECTED_STORAGE_KEY}" && : "${VITE_BASE_PATH:?missing VITE_BASE_PATH}" && node -e 'const ns=process.env.VITE_LOOP_STORAGE_NAMESPACE;const expectedKey=process.env.LOOP_EXPECTED_STORAGE_KEY;const basePath=process.env.VITE_BASE_PATH;const repo=process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY?process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY.split("/")[1]:null;function fail(m){console.error("test:e2e:preview-namespace guard: "+m);process.exit(1)};if(!/^pr-[0-9]+$/.test(ns))fail("invalid VITE_LOOP_STORAGE_NAMESPACE: "+ns);if(expectedKey!==`loop-protocol.preview.${ns}.mvp.save`)fail("invalid LOOP_EXPECTED_STORAGE_KEY: "+expectedKey);if(!basePath.startsWith("/")||!basePath.endsWith("/"))fail("invalid VITE_BASE_PATH (must start and end with /): "+basePath);if(basePath.includes("//"))fail("invalid VITE_BASE_PATH (double slash): "+basePath);const segs=basePath.split("/").filter((s)=>s.length>0);if(segs.length!==2)fail("invalid VITE_BASE_PATH (must be /<repo>/pr-N/): "+basePath);if(segs.some((s)=>s==="."||s===".."))fail("invalid VITE_BASE_PATH segment: "+basePath);if(!/^pr-[0-9]+$/.test(segs[1]))fail("invalid VITE_BASE_PATH namespace segment: "+basePath);if(segs[1]!==ns)fail("VITE_BASE_PATH namespace segment ("+segs[1]+") must equal VITE_LOOP_STORAGE_NAMESPACE ("+ns+")");if(repo&&segs[0]!==repo)fail("VITE_BASE_PATH repo segment ("+segs[0]+") must equal GITHUB_REPOSITORY repo name ("+repo+")");console.error("test:e2e:preview-namespace guard: ok ("+ns+", "+basePath+")")' && rm -rf dist && VITE_E2E_MODE=false pnpm build && pnpm dist:e2e-boundary --mode production --dist dist && LOOP_E2E_PREVIEW_NAMESPACE_LANE=true playwright test tests/e2e/m4-preview-namespace.spec.ts

scripts.test:vrt:evidence:triple-run: rm -rf tests/component/.vrt-evidence && for i in 1 2 3; do VITE_VRT_EVIDENCE_CAPTURE=true VITE_VRT_EVIDENCE_RUN_ID=$i pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.visual.config.ts tests/component/combat-hud-running.vrt.test.ts || exit 1; done && node -e "const {createHash}=require('node:crypto');const fs=require('node:fs');const hashes=[1,2,3].map((i)=>createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync('tests/component/.vrt-evidence/run-'+i+'/combat-hud-running-actual.png')).digest('hex'));console.log('actual_sha256_run_1='+hashes[0]);console.log('actual_sha256_run_2='+hashes[1]);console.log('actual_sha256_run_3='+hashes[2]);if(new Set(hashes).size!==1){console.error('MISMATCH: triple-run actual PNG sha256 differs across fresh processes');process.exit(1)}console.log('triple_run_stability=ok (3/3 identical sha256, fresh browser process each run)')"
